events.title: Relive Your Childhood: A Two-Day Fun Fair at M.E.T. Campus Sopore
events.description:
Global Youth Foundation organised a vibrant two-day Fun Fair at M.E.T. Campus, Sopore, bringing together entertainment, creativity and community spirit under the theme “Relive Your Childhood.” The event offered visitors a lively space to step away from routine and enjoy the simple joys of childhood.

The fair featured an exciting mix of shopping stalls, games and recreational activities, live music, art and craft stalls, food corners, exhibitions and much more. From creative displays and local products to fun-filled games and musical performances, every corner of the fair offered something engaging for visitors of all ages.

More than just an entertainment event, the Fun Fair created a shared platform for families, youngsters, artists, entrepreneurs and the local community to come together. With its cheerful atmosphere and diverse attractions, the programme celebrated the spirit of togetherness while giving everyone an opportunity to pause, reconnect and relive the joy of childhood.

events.title: Perish Smoking, Cherish Lives: Awareness Among School Students.
events.description:
Global Youth Foundation conducted the “Perish Smoking, Cherish Lives” awareness programme among school students to educate young minds about the harmful effects of smoking and tobacco use. The initiative focused on creating awareness at an early age and encouraging students to make healthy and responsible choices.

Through interactive sessions, discussions and awareness activities, students were sensitised about the physical, social and financial consequences associated with tobacco addiction. The programme also encouraged them to stay away from peer pressure and become positive influencers among their friends and communities.

The initiative carried the message that prevention begins with awareness. By empowering school students with the right knowledge and confidence, GYF sought to encourage a healthier generation and inspire young people to choose a life of health, purpose and dignity.

events.title: Youth Against Corruption: The Call for Integrity, Transparency and Change.
events.description:
Global Youth Foundation’s Youth Against Corruption initiative focused on engaging young people in creating greater awareness about the social and economic consequences of corruption. The programme encouraged youth to recognise the importance of honesty, transparency and accountability in everyday life and public affairs.

Through awareness activities, discussions and youth engagement, the initiative sought to inspire young minds to reject corrupt practices and become responsible citizens. It emphasised that lasting change begins with individuals who are willing to uphold integrity and speak for fairness.

The campaign reflected GYF’s belief that empowered and conscious youth can play an important role in promoting ethical values and building a more transparent and responsible society.

events.title: School Outreach Initiative 2012: Guiding Young Minds Towards a Responsible Future.
events.description:
In 2012, Global Youth Foundation undertook a series of visits to different schools across District Baramulla to engage with students on issues that could shape their future. The initiative created a direct platform for interaction with young minds, encouraging them to think beyond academics and become more aware of the opportunities, challenges and responsibilities that lie ahead.

During these interactions, students were encouraged to focus on education, personal development, social responsibility, discipline and constructive participation in their communities. The Foundation also emphasised the importance of making informed choices, developing positive values and using their talents and education for the betterment of society.

The school outreach programme reflected GYF’s belief that meaningful social change begins by engaging with young people at an early stage. By reaching classrooms and interacting directly with students, the initiative sought to inspire a generation that is confident, responsible and committed to contributing positively to the future of Jammu and Kashmir and the nation.

events.title: Nasha Mukt Jammu & Kashmir: A Collective Commitment Towards a Brighter Future
events.description: The Nasha Mukt Jammu & Kashmir initiative reflects a collective commitment towards building a healthier, safer and more responsible society, where the youth are empowered to pursue their dreams free from the grip of substance abuse. Organised by the Global Youth Foundation (GYF), the campaign brings together the administration, civil society and young people on a common platform to spread awareness about the devastating consequences of drug addiction and to encourage a culture of responsibility, resilience and hope. The presence and support of Hon’ble Lieutenant Governor Shri Manoj Sinha, along with the Deputy Commissioner, Baramulla, and the leadership of GYF President Mr. Touseef Mehraj Raina, further strengthened the message that the fight against drug abuse requires collective participation and sustained efforts. The initiative goes beyond awareness by calling upon every section of society to stand together, support those affected by addiction, protect vulnerable youth and create opportunities that give young people a positive direction in life. A Nasha Mukt Jammu & Kashmir is not merely a vision for tomorrow; it is a responsibility that must be embraced today, with every individual, institution and community contributing towards a healthier generation and a stronger future.

events.title: Solidarity Candlelight March in Tribute to Martyred JK Police Officer.
events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation organized a solemn candlelight march to pay tribute to a martyred officer of the Jammu and Kashmir Police. The march was held as a mark of respect, remembrance, and solidarity with the bereaved family and the police fraternity.

Volunteers, youth, and community members gathered peacefully, holding candles and observing moments of silence in honor of the officer’s courage and sacrifice in the line of duty. The atmosphere reflected unity, gratitude, and deep respect for those who dedicate their lives to safeguarding society.

Through this tribute, GYF reaffirmed its commitment to standing with institutions and families affected by such losses, while promoting peace, solidarity, and collective responsibility within the community.

events.title: STANDING WITH THE PEOPLE DURING THE 2014 FLOODS
events.subheading: Humanitarian Flood Relief, Rescue & Rehabilitation Operations
events.location: Flood-Ravaged Districts Across Kashmir Valley
banners: FLOOD RELIEF & HUMANITARIAN ACTION - GYF RESCUE TEAM
events.description:
During the devastating floods of 2014, when many families were stranded and homes were damaged, Global Youth Foundation (GYF) stepped forward to stand with the affected communities. Under the leadership of Touseef Raina, our team personally visited flood-affected areas to assess the ground situation and extend immediate support.

The images reflect those difficult days damaged houses, distressed families, and communities struggling to recover. GYF volunteers reached out to the affected households, listened to their concerns, and provided relief assistance and moral support at a time when it was needed most.

Our visit was not just about distributing aid; it was about solidarity. We stood with families in their villages, shared their pain, and reassured them that they were not alone. Through coordinated efforts, community support, and volunteer engagement, GYF contributed to relief and rehabilitation efforts during one of the most challenging times in the region.

The 2014 floods remain a reminder of resilience, unity, and the importance of timely humanitarian response values that continue to guide our mission today.

events.title: BUILDING HARMONY THROUGH YOUTH ENGAGEMENT
events.subheading: Campaign: “Jawan Aur Awam Aman Hai Makaam”
events.location: Open Grounds & Pine Cleared Greens, North Kashmir
banners: JAWAN AUR AWAM AMAN HAI MAKAAM
events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation recently organized a community engagement program under its ongoing campaign “Jawan Aur Awam Aman Hai Makaam,” reaffirming its commitment to fostering trust, harmony, and meaningful connections among young people and the wider community.

The program brought together school children, predominantly young girls along with several boys, who participated enthusiastically alongside GYF volunteers. Gathered under the Foundation’s banner in an open and welcoming setting, the children shared moments of joy, interaction, and collective spirit that reflected the essence of the campaign.

A series of recreational activities formed the core of the event. Students took part in friendly running races, indoor games such as carom, and a light net game that encouraged teamwork and cooperation. The emphasis remained on participation, confidence building, and creating a safe space where children could express themselves freely while learning the values of unity and mutual respect.

Through such initiatives, GYF continues to promote peace building, community cohesion, and the empowerment of young girls. The Foundation extends its sincere appreciation to the participating children, dedicated volunteers, and local supporters whose cooperation made the program a success. These efforts remain central to GYF’s vision of nurturing a more harmonious and progressive society.

events.title: GREEN TOMORROW BEGINS TODAY: PLANTATION DRIVE BY GLOBAL YOUTH FOUNDATION
events.subheading: School Environmental Stewardship & Native Sapling Plantation
events.location: Govt Higher Secondary Schools Across Kashmir
events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation successfully conducted a plantation drive across various schools with the aim of promoting environmental awareness and encouraging young minds to take responsibility for a greener future. Students, teachers, and volunteers actively participated in planting saplings within school premises, symbolizing a collective commitment towards sustainability and ecological balance.

The initiative not only focused on increasing green cover but also on educating students about the importance of trees in combating climate change, improving air quality, and preserving biodiversity. The drive witnessed enthusiastic involvement from school authorities and children, making it a meaningful step toward nurturing environmental consciousness at the grassroots level.

Through such initiatives, the Global Youth Foundation continues to strengthen its mission of community development and youth engagement, inspiring the next generation to become responsible stewards of the environment.

The Global Youth Foundation organized an awareness programme focused on addressing the growing concern of drug addiction and its impact on youth and society. The initiative was aimed at educating young people about the physical, psychological, and social consequences of substance abuse, while encouraging a culture of prevention, responsibility, and informed decision making.

The programme brought together students, community members, and volunteers who participated in interactive sessions and open discussions. Resource persons highlighted the serious health risks associated with drug dependency and emphasized the importance of early awareness, strong family support, and positive peer influence. Participants were encouraged to speak openly about the challenges faced by young people and the pressures that can lead to harmful choices.

Through this initiative, the Foundation reinforced the message that awareness and community engagement are powerful tools in combating addiction. By promoting healthy lifestyles, constructive activities, and strong support systems, GYF continues to work toward safeguarding the future of our youth.

events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation has consistently upheld the principle that peaceful and lawful expression is a vital pillar of a democratic society. In this spirit, the Foundation has organized and supported peaceful protests to raise awareness against various forms of injustice affecting communities.

These initiatives have included candlelight gatherings, silent marches, signature campaigns, and public awareness drives. Each programme was conducted with discipline and respect, ensuring that the message of justice, accountability, and reform was conveyed constructively. Youth participation remained central, reflecting their growing commitment to standing against inequality and unfair practices through lawful means.

By advocating nonviolence, dialogue, and civic responsibility, GYF continues to encourage communities to raise their voices in a manner that promotes harmony while seeking positive and meaningful change

events.title: Promoting Women’s Hygiene and Dignity: Awareness Programme and Distribution Drive
events.subheading: “Wings of Hope” Menstrual Health Education & Sanitary Pad Distribution
events.location: Rural Villages & Community Centers, North Kashmir
banners: GLOBAL YOUTH FOUNDATION PRESENTS WINGS OF HOPE
events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation organized a dedicated programme on women’s hygiene aimed at spreading awareness about menstrual health and breaking the stigma surrounding it. The initiative focused on educating young girls and women about the importance of proper hygiene practices, health awareness, and self-care.

As part of the programme, sanitary napkins were distributed among participants to ensure access to safe and hygienic menstrual products. The session included informative discussions on menstrual health management, the importance of cleanliness, and addressing common misconceptions.

Through this effort, GYF reaffirmed its commitment to safeguarding the health, dignity, and confidence of women and girls. The Foundation continues to undertake such initiatives to promote awareness, accessibility, and empowerment within the community.

The Global Youth Foundation, in collaboration with the JK Imam Association, organized a Drug De Addiction Camp aimed at addressing the growing concern of substance abuse among youth. The initiative focused on awareness, counseling, and community engagement to promote a healthier and drug free society.

The camp brought together community members, students, and volunteers who participated in informative sessions highlighting the physical, psychological, and social consequences of drug dependency. Resource persons emphasized the importance of early intervention, family support, and moral guidance in preventing addiction and supporting recovery.

Through this collaborative effort, both organizations reaffirmed their shared commitment to safeguarding the well-being of young people and encouraging positive lifestyle choices. The programme served as a meaningful step toward building awareness, strengthening community responsibility, and promoting long term social reform.

events.title: COMMUNITY DIALOGUE WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS ON DE RADICALIZATION AND SOCIAL HARMONY
events.subheading: Consultative Conference on Tolerance, Guidance & Social Harmony at Hotel Lalrukh
events.location: Hotel Lalrukh Conference Hall, Srinagar, J&K
banners: HOTEL LALRUKH - CONSULTATIVE DIALOGUE ON HARMONY
events.description:
The Global Youth Foundation organized a consultative programme with respected Imams and religious scholars to address the important issue of de radicalization and the promotion of peace within society.

The discussion centered on the collective responsibility of community leaders in guiding youth toward constructive and lawful paths. The Imams highlighted the core values of faith rooted in compassion, tolerance, and coexistence, while emphasizing the need to prevent misinterpretations that can negatively influence young minds.

Participants stressed the importance of education, moral guidance, and strong community engagement in countering extremist narratives and fostering balanced thinking. The programme concluded with a shared commitment to strengthening social harmony and ensuring that religious institutions continue to serve as pillars of unity and positive guidance.

Through such initiatives, GYF continues to work toward building an informed, peaceful, and resilient society.
